event_name: Time 15:18 2018 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 June 2018 Having received a recommendation from the Race Director to reduce the pit lane speed limit to 60 km/h for the rest of the Event, the Stewards decide in accordance with Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations that the speed limit shall be 60 km/h for the rest of the Event.
